### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

[ Learn more ][229]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,

## How Can MDI Meet Your Challenge?

MDI has been providing excellence in molding and engineering for over 50 years. We have been
integral in solving supply chain and contract manufacturing challenges for OEMs in every industry.

#### Expert Provider of Customized Plastic Injection Molding

With more than fifty years of serving a wide range of global markets, you can depend on us to
provide the solutions you need for your [plastic molding projects][94], on time and within the
agreed budget.

#### Innovative Design in Our Custom Plastic Parts

No matter how demanding your specifications might be, we have the advanced machinery and skilled
workforce to deliver. From the initial [design and development][95] phases, through production,
assembly – we apply innovative engineering techniques to ensure your custom parts consistently meet
a rigorous quality standard

#### Wide Range of Innovative Techniques

The techniques we offer include [custom blow molding][96], [dip molding & coating Services][97],
[injection molding services][98], as well as specialist solutions for [medical injection
molding][99] applications.

#### Helping With Your Medical Product Design Needs

Do you have a great idea for a medical device? Medical device product development can be a difficult
process without some professional guidance. We offer custom medical device contract manufacturing at
various scales of production.

Our goal is to provide you with the exact parts you need, while also meeting your production and
timeline requirements. Meticulous planning and attention to detail helps us move seamlessly from
design to prototype to full-scale production, and provide quality injection molding services for a
wide array of industries.

#### Expert Provider of Customized Plastic Injection Molding

manufacturability analysis, you can count on our [world-class engineering][100] talent for a

statistical process control, we pride ourselves in a commitment to quality that provides exactly
what our customers want, when they need it.

more. Looking for assembly services? We can take that on as well! MDI can even serve as your
warehousing and drop shipping solution.

One of the most advanced secondary services offered at Molded Device Inc. is ultrasonic welding.
Exceptionally fast, efficient and reliable – [ultrasonic welding][101] is one of the best methods
for joining plastic parts and components, creating a durable and lasting bond

production, energy production, and aerospace and defense.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Critical Airway Innovations

Skip to entry content

[Nevap_Logo_03]

## **The Mission**

**Airway management devices that improve outcomes, reduce complications, and lower costs. **

## **The Aspire Subglottic Endotracheal Tube**

Airway Management doesn’t end once an artificial airway is placed, as breathing tubes can act as a
path for infectious agents to enter the lower airways. This is why the leading risk factor for
pneumonia (post-operative, ventilator-associated, and aspiration pneumonia) is the presence of a
breathing tube.

**Subglottic drainage** of the human airway is recommended by the **CDC, AHRQ, ATS, SHEA, APIC,
IDSA, AACN**, and many other scientific associations because numerous meta-analysis and randomized
control trials show it reduces **time on mechanical ventilation**, **pneumonia incidence**,
**antibiotic needs**, and **mortality** in long-term ventilated patients.  

The NEVAP Aspire Subglottic Suction Endotracheal Tube (ASSET) is the only subglottic breathing tube
designed with a tissue spacer and multiple ports to prevent tissue blockage. This design results in
significantly better airway drainage and  and the ability to apply this infection prevention
strategy in the ICU, OR, and ED. 

 

Here is a simply visual demonstration. 10ml of thick fluid, mimicking tracheal secretions was added
into an acrylic tube and 100mm Hg suctioning was applied.  The NEVAP ASSET (Right) and a single port
subglottic breathing tube were compared. Cuff pressure was continuously monitored and maintained at
25mm H2O.

**The Other Suction Tubes                                       The NEVAP ASSET**

# Critical Airway Innovations

Skip to entry content

[Nevap_Logo_03]

## **The Mission**

**Airway management devices that improve outcomes, reduce complications, and lower costs. **

## **The Aspire Subglottic Endotracheal Tube**

Airway Management doesn’t end once an artificial airway is placed, as breathing tubes can act as a
path for infectious agents to enter the lower airways. This is why the leading risk factor for
pneumonia (post-operative, ventilator-associated, and aspiration pneumonia) is the presence of a
breathing tube.

**Subglottic drainage** of the human airway is recommended by the **CDC, AHRQ, ATS, SHEA, APIC,
IDSA, AACN**, and many other scientific associations because numerous meta-analysis and randomized
control trials show it reduces **time on mechanical ventilation**, **pneumonia incidence**,
**antibiotic needs**, and **mortality** in long-term ventilated patients.  

The NEVAP Aspire Subglottic Suction Endotracheal Tube (ASSET) is the only subglottic breathing tube
designed with a tissue spacer and multiple ports to prevent tissue blockage. This design results in
significantly better airway drainage and  and the ability to apply this infection prevention
strategy in the ICU, OR, and ED. 

 

Here is a simply visual demonstration. 10ml of thick fluid, mimicking tracheal secretions was added
into an acrylic tube and 100mm Hg suctioning was applied.  The NEVAP ASSET (Right) and a single port
subglottic breathing tube were compared. Cuff pressure was continuously monitored and maintained at
25mm H2O.

* ## Breakthrough technology proven to address antimicrobial resistance
  
  ###### Up to 84% reduction of postoperative infection rates demonstrated in major Canadian
  ###### hospitals.
HOME[amanda@vanepercy.com][18]2026-03-04T15:06:28-08:00

**Ondine Biomedical Inc. **is a Canadian life sciences company pioneering light-activated therapies
designed to prevent and treat infections, including those caused by drug-resistant pathogens.

Our patented photodisinfection platform technology targets harmful microbes without contributing to
antimicrobial resistance, offering a powerful new approach to infection prevention.

## Recent News
* #### [Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust to use Steriwave][19]
  
  June 30, 2026
* #### [Nasal Photodisinfection Reduces Surgical Infections in Complex Brain Surgery by 78.5%
  #### Compared to Nasal Antibiotics at Leeds Teaching Hospitals][20]
  
  June 18, 2026
* #### [Steriwave ICU Study Outcomes Presented at CSRT2026][21]
  
  May 26, 2026

[Read more][22]

## About Photodisinfection

Photodisinfection is a platform technology that destroys bacteria, viruses, yeasts and fungi and
their associated virulence factors in minutes.

Photodisinfection involves applying a photosensitive agent to the area to be treated, followed by
illumination with non-thermal laser light for a few minutes. This targeted light activation causes
an oxidative burst which destroys the pathogens. When the light is turned off, the reaction ceases.

##### How it works

Video from the [International Photodynamic Association][23]. Used with permission.

##### Benefits of photodisinfection

Unlike antibiotics, which require hours to days to exert their effect, photodisinfection destroys
pathogens immediately upon light activation. Due to the rapid oxidative effects, pathogens are
unable to develop resistance.

Photodisinfection has many advantages, including:
* Kills pathogens with **no resistance formation**.
* Produces **potent anti-inflammatory** effects.
* **Safe, fast and painless** treatment for patients.
* **Simple clinical adoption** and low impact to healthcare workflows.
* No complicated compliance requirements.
* Provides significant **time and cost savings** to healthcare systems.

[READ MORE][24]

## Our Products

[

## Steriwave™

][25]

A rapid nasal decolonization therapy that eradicates a broad spectrum of pathogens in the nose in
only minutes. Steriwave enables rapid elimination of pathogens associated with healthcare-associated
infections (HAIs), reduces the reliance on patient compliance and screening, and eliminates the
generation of resistance associated with topical antibiotics and other antimicrobials.

Steriwave treatment destroys nasal pathogens (including Staphylococcus aureus, Candida auris,
SARS-CoV-2, MRSA and other superbugs). Eliminating nasal pathogens has been demonstrated to
significantly reduce a person’s risk of infection or passing the pathogens along to others. Over the
past decade, Steriwave has helped Vancouver General Hospital reduce its surgical site infections
(SSIs) by over 80%.

## Product pipeline

In addition to our lead product, Steriwave, we also have a number of products in development,
including treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis, decolonization of burns and wounds, disinfection of
endotracheal tubes to reduce the incidence of ventilator-associated pneumonia and most recently, the
development of topical antiviral therapy for the upper respiratory tract, including the reduction of
SARS-CoV-2 titre and transmission.

**Products not for sale in the U.S.**

## Join Our Team


Our people share a common vision and a dedication to performance. We pride ourselves on our ability
to attract and retain highly qualified and motivated people for all areas of the company. If you
would like to be considered for a current or future opportunity, please send your resume to:
hr@ondinebio.com

* ## Breakthrough technology proven to address antimicrobial resistance

HOME[amanda@vanepercy.com][18]2026-03-04T15:06:28-08:00

**Ondine Biomedical Inc. **is a Canadian life sciences company pioneering light-activated therapies
designed to prevent and treat infections, including those caused by drug-resistant pathogens.

Our patented photodisinfection platform technology targets harmful microbes without contributing to
antimicrobial resistance, offering a powerful new approach to infection prevention.

## Recent News
* #### [Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust to use Steriwave][19]
  
  June 30, 2026
* #### [Nasal Photodisinfection Reduces Surgical Infections in Complex Brain Surgery by 78.5%
  #### Compared to Nasal Antibiotics at Leeds Teaching Hospitals][20]
  
  June 18, 2026
* #### [Steriwave ICU Study Outcomes Presented at CSRT2026][21]
  
  May 26, 2026

[Read more][22]

## About Photodisinfection

Photodisinfection is a platform technology that destroys bacteria, viruses, yeasts and fungi and
their associated virulence factors in minutes.

Photodisinfection involves applying a photosensitive agent to the area to be treated, followed by
illumination with non-thermal laser light for a few minutes. This targeted light activation causes
an oxidative burst which destroys the pathogens. When the light is turned off, the reaction ceases.

##### How it works

Video from the [International Photodynamic Association][23]. Used with permission.

##### Benefits of photodisinfection

Unlike antibiotics, which require hours to days to exert their effect, photodisinfection destroys
pathogens immediately upon light activation. Due to the rapid oxidative effects, pathogens are
unable to develop resistance.

Photodisinfection has many advantages, including:
* Kills pathogens with **no resistance formation**.
* Produces **potent anti-inflammatory** effects.
* **Safe, fast and painless** treatment for patients.
* **Simple clinical adoption** and low impact to healthcare workflows.
* No complicated compliance requirements.
* Provides significant **time and cost savings** to healthcare systems.

[READ MORE][24]

## Our Products

[

## Steriwave™

][25]

A rapid nasal decolonization therapy that eradicates a broad spectrum of pathogens in the nose in
only minutes. Steriwave enables rapid elimination of pathogens associated with healthcare-associated
infections (HAIs), reduces the reliance on patient compliance and screening, and eliminates the
generation of resistance associated with topical antibiotics and other antimicrobials.

Steriwave treatment destroys nasal pathogens (including Staphylococcus aureus, Candida auris,
SARS-CoV-2, MRSA and other superbugs). Eliminating nasal pathogens has been demonstrated to
significantly reduce a person’s risk of infection or passing the pathogens along to others. Over the
past decade, Steriwave has helped Vancouver General Hospital reduce its surgical site infections
(SSIs) by over 80%.

## Product pipeline

In addition to our lead product, Steriwave, we also have a number of products in development,
including treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis, decolonization of burns and wounds, disinfection of
endotracheal tubes to reduce the incidence of ventilator-associated pneumonia and most recently, the
development of topical antiviral therapy for the upper respiratory tract, including the reduction of
SARS-CoV-2 titre and transmission.

**Products not for sale in the U.S.**

sacrificing the comfort needed for long shifts. Understanding the technical specifications and
proper application of these garments is essential for maintaining a sterile clinical environment and

## Empowering next-gen providers to thrive with easily accessible Actionable Data.

## We don't just help

## We help nurture it.

## Elevate your outreach efforts with our clinically trained
## Patient Care Team.

[Request a Demo][17]

## Transforming data into patient care.

The only cardiac data management company with a full-suite patient-care ecosystem that transforms
data from any device into life-saving insights and enhances patient outreach with a clinically
trained patient-engagement team.

[Learn More][18]
[Rhythm 360 Logo]

## **We simplify complex healthcare data to nurture patient health and empower care teams.**

Let us partner with you to manage

### Hypertension

Monitor longitudinal journey of hypertensive patients

### Heart Failure

Manage patient journey with automated, AI driven care pathways for remote monitoring using connected
external devices and/or implanted devices

### **Rhythm Management (CIEDs & Loops)**

Comprehensive cardiac device ecosystem provides effective data capture for standardized reports

### **Ambulatory Cardiac Monitors**

MCOTs, wearable EKGs, Cardiac patch monitoring, and more.

[Get Started][19]

## Revolutionize cardiac care with RhythmScience

### Better data. Simple workflows.

**Rhythm360®** is an integrated platform that creates a unified workspace to review, interpret, and
utilize data from patients and devices for hypertension management, heart failure management, and
rhythm management [CIEDs, MCOTs, EKGs, etc]. Receive actionable data from implantable or external
cardiac devices for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and rhythm disorders.

Access critical cardiology data with simple workflows.

[Learn more][20]
[Platform Screenshot]

### Remote cardiology made simple.

Technical services teams can supplement existing clinical care teams to provide expert patient
engagement services. Trained team members are available to help with alert management, patient
compliance, and health coaching.

Always on even when you're off.

##### About Us

# Welcome to Ribbel International Limited

**The World's Leading Manufacturer of Surgical Blades & Foley Catheters**

[Ribbel International][13] Limited, founded in 1992, is one of India’s most trusted medical devices
manufacturers & internationally recognized in the medical devices industry for its high quality &
reliable products. Based in Haryana, we manufacture and globally export [Foley Balloon
Catheter][14], Surgical [Scalpel Blades][15], [Urine Bags][16], [Endotracheal Tubes][17] and
[Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes][18].

We have over 30 years of experience and distribution in over 40 countries - With every product we
develop we make sure we add precision, safety and performance for the end user!

###### 30+ YearsExperience

###### 40+Export Countries

###### CertifiedQuality

###### TrustedBy Experts

##### Our Products

## Precision Engineered Medical Devices

[Foley Balloon Catheter]

##### Foley Balloon Catheter

Crafted for patient safety, our Foley Catheters are manufactured in high-grade medical silicone and
latex, engineered for easy insertion and minimal trauma.

[Know More][19]
[Scalpel Blades]

##### Scalpel Blades

Manufactured using precision German grinding machines from Solingen, our blades deliver unmatched
sharpness and durability trusted by surgeons globally.

[Know More][20]
[Urine Bags]

##### Urine Bags

Hygienic, leak-proof, and comfortable. Designed for use in hospitals, nursing homes, and for
post-operative care.

[Know More][21]
[Endotracheal Tubes]

##### Endotracheal Tubes

Available in plain and reinforced variants. Designed for effective airway management during surgery
and intensive care.

[Know More][22]
[Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes]

##### Prefilled Saline Flush Syringes

Sterile, pre-filled, single-use syringes with saline solution, reducing reflux and enhancing patient
safety in catheter maintenance.

[Know More][23]

##### Why Choose Ribbel?

### Built on Trust, Quality & Innovation

##### Global Quality Standards

We are certified by international medical standards, and have been relied upon by hospitals
worldwide.

##### State-of-the-Art Infrastructure

We have the latest machinery from Germany with an in-house R&D department and toolroom or workshop.

##### Massively Scalable Manufacturing

We manufacture over 100 million blades annually so fulfilling bulk requirements is no challenge.

##### Global Recognition

Our products are known and preferred by leading distributors and hospitals from Brazil to Saudi
Arabia.

[Learn More][24]

##### Quick Enquiry

### We’re Here to Help You

Have questions about our products or services? Our team is ready to assist you with the right
information and guidance. Just drop us a quick enquiry and we’ll get back to you shortly.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

## About RWD

As a progressive scientific equipment company, RWD introduces the up-to-date laboratory equipment to
the industry including the Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging System, stereotaxic instruments and so on.
Our scientific instruments service is applicable to animal surgery and modeling, neural circuit
signal, cell & molecular biology, microcirculation monitoring, pathological diagnosis, and
veterinary medical science.

Our top-tier research and development team has helped RWD to acquire nearly 100 invention and
utility model patents worldwide, encompassing core technologies in different fields from
neuroscience research, molecular and cellular research, respiration and anesthesia, and to
pathological diagnosis products, and more.

Since 2002, we have been exploring more possibilities in the USA scientific instruments company
sector. Besides, forming partnerships with different enterprises enhances our competitiveness in the
USA scientific equipment company sector.

RWD believes that the scientific instruments USA company sector should take the lead in promoting
continuous learning within the medical science industry. Therefore, apart from being a scientific
instruments service provider, we have established the RWD Academy to share supplementary knowledge
about laboratory technology. We have taken a step ahead of the scientific equipment company USA
sector by organising both online and offline seminars.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.
